sha256_note: Every row carries sha256:null by design (T11 rail: no binaries mirrored beyond tiny liveness probes). T12's fetch.mjs --seal mode fills this per row on first real fetch, then verifies on every later run — schema does not change shape when it does.

sources.name: Poly Haven

licence.quote: Poly Haven publishes its ENTIRE library... under CC0 1.0 (public-domain dedication): no attribution required, commercial use allowed, no share-alike.

sources.coverage_note: 521 total models catalogued (api.polyhaven.com/assets?type=models, keyless, fetched 2026-09-01). Strong on photoreal PBR seating/tables/lighting/plants. ZERO bathroom fixtures, ZERO wardrobes/closets/dressers, ZERO rugs (all confirmed by keyword sweep of all 521 names). All 5 of its sofo(a) models are vintage/antique by their OWN description text — see RESEARCH.md.

sources.name: Kenney — Furniture Kit

licence.quote: "Download this package (140 assets) for free, CC0 licensed!" — licence cell links "Creative Commons CC0" to the CC0 deed.

sources.coverage_note: ONE CC0 pack, 140 named single-file .glb models (verified via `unzip -Z1` on a one-time scratchpad-only download, not committed anywhere — T12 refetches fresh per rail 4). Covers every one of the 6 standard room types including full bathroom fixtures and rugs, both categories Poly Haven has zero of. Low-poly flat-shaded game-asset style — geometry is clean/modern but untextured beyond flat colour; T12 will want a materials pass (see RESEARCH.md style-coherence risk).

sources.name: Quaternius (origin), individually mirrored on Poly Pizza

licence.quote: Origin (quaternius.com): license = "CC0" linking the CC0 deed, stated for all packs including Ultimate Furniture Pack. Mirror (poly.pizza asset page) independently shows "CC0 1.0" for this exact file, linking the same deed, author credited "Quaternius".

sources.coverage_note: Quaternius's OWN site only offers pack-level bulk downloads (a Google Drive folder link for Ultimate Furniture Pack — fragile, no stable per-file URL, no HEAD-checkable liveness). poly.pizza mirrors many individual Quaternius CC0 files with stable static.poly.pizza direct URLs (HEAD-verified 200, gltf-binary) AND independently redisplays "CC0 1.0" + the CC0 deed link + "Quaternius" author credit on each mirrored asset page — used here purely as the practical per-file download vector for two specific modern sofas; licence authority is still Quaternius's own CC0 statement.
